limitations: Screened final MTA predictions and declared walks remain proxy outcomes.
This audit verifies exact selected journeys, not an adaptive passenger taking another Stay train.
A separate auditor checks same-cutoff alternative Stay trains.

Four narrow positive Switch journeys have only 3.27 to 9.30 seconds of initial boarding slack under declared access walks; two are already practical ties. These are assumption-sensitive, not guaranteed passenger catches.

The largest narrow 857-second gain becomes an 82-second practical tie when the separately audited earlier, actually catchable same-cutoff local 7 train is used as the Stay comparator. Frozen original counts remain unchanged.

The 10 additional gains above 15 minutes compare the model Switch with its own forecast-selected Stay train; they are separate from the 21 raw-MTA Stay/model Switch positives and are not additional proof of advantage over raw-MTA advice.
